sources.name: Tennessee Department of Revenue: Hall income tax
Tennessee Revenue: Hall income tax repealed beginning January 1, 2021

notes: No state income tax is withheld from wages and no employee-paid state payroll programs. Employer-side taxes do not reduce employee pay.

Tennessee Department of Revenue states the Hall tax never applied to wages and was repealed for tax years from 2021, and that Tennessee has no income tax withholding requirement (read via search result 2026-10-18).

Sign-off recorded 2026-10-18 on the owner's instruction, after the numbers were compared with the sources listed in this file. Editorial text in src/lib/states.ts and any limits listed above were not independently reviewed.
